def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    # Tile the source with its rotations: original, clockwise, counterclockwise, 180 degrees.
    cw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    ccw = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    rot180 = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[i] + cw[i] for i in range(n)] + [ccw[i] + rot180[i] for i in range(n)]
